== Description ==

[[Benji Chu]] (right, green Team Albany shirt) and [[Brian Fred]] (left, arm only) shaking hands at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 5 October 2025, with [[Mike Kessling]] (standing left, blue New Allies T-shirt) and [[Matt Scott]] (standing right, black Nike track jacket with white sleeve stripes); one standing face in a black shirt remains unlabeled.
